segments.name: Hydroelectric
segments.description: Operates hydroelectric generating facilities and sells the power they produce to utilities and other customers under long-term contracts.
segments.evidence: The operations of the company are segmented by – 1) hydroelectric, 2) wind, 3) utility-scale solar, 4) distributed energy & sustainable solutions (distributed generation, pumped storage, carbon capture and storage, cogeneration, biomass, and eFuels) and 5) corporate.

segments.name: Wind

segments.name: Distributed energy & sustainable solutions
segments.description: Provides distributed generation, storage and other sustainable solutions that sell power and services to customers under long-term contracts.
segments.evidence: The operations of the company are segmented by – 1) hydroelectric, 2) wind, 3) utility-scale solar, 4) distributed energy & sustainable solutions (distributed generation, pumped storage, carbon capture and storage, cogeneration, biomass, and eFuels) and 5) corporate.

revenueModel.text: Utilities and other buyers pay for electricity and capacity sold under long-term power purchase agreements from the company's generating facilities.
revenueModel.evidence: the underlying cash flows generated by the assets are supported by strong margins and stable, long-term power purchase agreements

changes.text: In 2025 Brookfield Renewable sold a portfolio of wind and solar assets in India.
changes.evidence: In April 2025, Brookfield Renewable, together with institutional partners, completed the sale of a 1,004 MW portfolio of wind and solar assets in India in separate tranches for proceeds of approximately $188 million ($52 million net to Brookfield Renewable).

changes.text: In 2025 Brookfield Renewable sold a portfolio of operating distributed generation assets and an interest in a distributed generation development platform in the United States.
changes.evidence: In December 2025, Brookfield Renewable, together with institutional partners, completed the sale of a 1.5 GW portfolio of operating distributed generation assets and a 47% interest in a 2.3 GW distributed generation development platform in the United States for base proceeds of approximately $1.1 billion ($449 million net to Brookfield Renewable).
